chapter: 御避灾患章第六十五 至 出痘、是病非病
chapter_en: Chapters 65-66 and the following passages on pox and real illness

units.chapter_en: Chapter 65: Guarding against and avoiding calamity
units.title: 御避灾患：防灾避患忌官爻——安静休囚祸不招，遇旺遇生灾速起，无或落空陷则病潜消，不伤身世无魔瘴，日月制之殃咎散，子孙一动灭邪妖；无鬼便无灾

rule.yi: 这一章讲防灾避患，吉的事用子孙爻为主，凶的事用官鬼爻为凭。防灾避患最忌官爻：官爻安静、休囚，祸招不来；遇到旺、遇到生，灾很快就起；官爻没有或落陷，病就悄悄消了；官爻不伤世和卦身，就没有魔障；如果发动，就难逃；日、月制住它，殃咎就散；子孙一动，邪妖就灭。注说：占自己有没有病，要仔细看官鬼，鬼逢生旺，灾一定来得快；落空亡或不上卦，永远不会成灾；鬼发动怎么会不生灾？不克世和卦身，终究没有疾厄；官爻虽然动，只要子孙同时发动、或者子孙临日月、或者子孙在世爻上，万祸都悄悄消了；没有鬼就没有灾。
rule.en: This chapter is about guarding against calamity and avoiding trouble: for good outcomes take Output as the main line, for bad ones the Pressure line as the ground. To guard against calamity one fears the Pressure line: still, resting or trapped, it brings no misfortune; meeting strength or generation, calamity rises quickly; absent or fallen, the illness quietly fades; if it does not harm the Self and the Body there is no demonic obstruction; if it moves, it can hardly be escaped; if the Day and Month control it, the calamity disperses; when Output moves, evil and demons are wiped out. The commentary says: in divining whether one has illness, examine the Pressure line closely; if the ghost meets generation or strength, calamity is sure to come quickly; if it falls into Void or is absent from the hexagram, it will never cause trouble; if the ghost moves, how could it not breed calamity? But if it does not control the Self and the Body, in the end there is no illness; even if the Pressure line moves, if Output moves with it, or Output sits on the Day or Month, or Output is on the Self, ten thousand misfortunes quietly fade; no ghost, no calamity.

zh: 吉则用子孙为主，凶则用官鬼为凭。
yi: 吉的事用子孙爻为主，凶的事用官鬼爻为凭。
en: For good outcomes take Output as the main line, for bad ones take the Pressure line as the ground.

zh: 防灾避患忌官爻，安静休囚祸不招，
遇旺遇生灾速起，或无或陷病潜消，
不伤身世无魔瘴，如值交重难莫逃，
日月制之殃咎散，子孙一动灭邪妖。
yi: 防灾避患最忌官爻，官爻安静、休囚，祸就招不来；
遇到旺、遇到生，灾很快就起；官爻没有或落陷，病就悄悄消了；
不伤世和卦身，就没有魔障；如果碰上发动，就难逃了；
日、月制住它，殃咎就散了；子孙一动，邪妖就灭了。
en: To guard against calamity and avoid trouble one fears the Pressure line: still, resting or trapped, it brings no misfortune;
meeting strength or generation, calamity rises quickly; absent or fallen, the illness quietly fades;
if it does not harm the Self and the Body there is no demonic obstruction; if it moves, it can hardly be escaped;
if the Day and Month control it, the calamity disperses; when Output moves, evil and demons are wiped out.

zh: 凡占自身疾病有无，当详官鬼，鬼逢生旺必见灾速。
若落空亡或不上卦，永不为殃。
鬼如发动岂不生灾，不克世身终无疾厄，官爻虽动，若得子孙同发、或子临日月、或子孙居世，万祸潜消。
无鬼便无灾。
yi: 凡是占自己有没有病，要仔细看官鬼；鬼逢生旺，灾一定来得快。
如果落空亡，或者不上卦，就永远不会成灾。
鬼如果发动，怎么会不生灾？但只要不克世和卦身，终究没有疾厄；官爻虽然动，如果子孙同时发动、或者子孙临日月、或者子孙在世爻上，万祸都悄悄消了。
没有鬼就没有灾。
en: In divining whether one has illness, examine the Pressure line closely; if the ghost meets generation or strength, calamity is sure to come quickly.
If it falls into Void or is absent from the hexagram, it will never cause trouble.

If the ghost moves, how could it not breed calamity? But if it does not control the Self and the Body, in the end there is no illness; even if the Pressure line moves, if Output moves with it, or Output sits on the Day or Month, or Output is on the Self, ten thousand misfortunes quietly fade.
No ghost, no calamity.

note.yi: 这一章防的是还没得的病：占自己会不会遇灾、有没有病，不是占已经在病的人，所以吉凶两头各取一个主爻——吉看子孙、凶看官鬼。「魔瘴」是妖魔邪祟造成的障碍。易冒的初筮防疾一条（LY.ILL.YM.28）是同一件事，也是「用坏病起、鬼发病作」，看的也是鬼。
note.en: This chapter is about guarding against an illness not yet contracted: whether one will meet calamity or have illness, not about someone already sick, so a main line is taken at each end, Output for good and Pressure for bad. 'Demonic obstruction' is the hindrance caused by demons and evil influences. The Yi Mao's entry on guarding against illness in a first divination (LY.ILL.YM.28) is the same matter, 'the Subject spoiled, the illness rises; the ghost moves, the illness breaks out', and it too looks at the ghost.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 65: Guarding against and avoiding calamity
units.title: 谁爻化鬼谁人犯、那命临官那个遭：父爻化鬼灾至椿萱、兄化官祸延手足、子化官殃从儿女、财之用象病在妻奴、世化官病临自己、应位为鬼妻妾不宁；本命临官必为灾；问病有无，忌神不动、鬼不交重、用神不空破便言平安

rule.yi: 哪个爻变出鬼，是哪个人犯的；哪个人的本命落在官鬼上，是哪个人遭殃；再看六亲里谁受克，轻重就能判断得分毫不差。再说全家有没有人生病，要去找用象：父爻变出鬼，灾落到父母身上；兄弟变出官，祸延及兄弟姐妹；子孙变出官爻，灾殃从儿女来；财爻的用象，病在妻子和仆人；世爻变出官爻，病落在自己身上；应位是鬼，妻妾不安宁。再查每个人的本命，落在官鬼上的，一定成灾，比如占得某卦，午火临官，就说属马的人受患；鬼如果空亡，不这样断，要再看六亲的象，不能受伤。财爻动，祸事忧及长辈；鬼兴旺，灾殃波及兄弟；兄弟摇动，妻子生病；父爻动，儿女有灾；如果妻子来占，子孙动，丈夫受患；其余占问，子孙兴旺都是平安。问有没有病，卦里忌神不动、鬼不发动、用神不遇旬空月破，就说平安。
rule.en: Whichever line changes into a ghost, that person has offended; whichever natal branch sits on the Pressure line, that person suffers; moreover see which of the six relations is controlled, and severity can be judged to the finest degree. Again, to judge whether anyone in the whole household falls ill, one must find the Subject image: if the Resource line changes into a ghost, calamity reaches the father and mother; if Peer changes into Pressure, misfortune spreads to brothers and sisters; if Output changes into a Pressure line, misfortune comes through the children; for the Wealth image, the illness lies with the wife and servants; if the Self changes into a Pressure line, the illness falls on oneself; if the Other's place is the ghost, wife and concubines are unsettled. Then check each person's natal branch: whoever's falls on the Pressure line will surely suffer calamity, so that if a certain hexagram is obtained and Wu Fire sits on the Pressure line, one says the person born in the year of the Horse suffers; if the ghost is Void, do not judge this way, but look further at the image of the six relations, which must not be harmed. Wealth moving, misfortune worries the elders; the ghost thriving, calamity reaches the brothers; the Peer stirring, the wife falls ill; the Resource moving, the children have calamity; if the wife divines and Output moves, the husband suffers; in all other questions Output thriving means peace. To ask whether there is illness: if the Adversary is still, the ghost does not move, and the Subject does not meet Void or Month-break, say all is well.

zh: 谁爻化鬼谁人犯，那命临官那个遭，
更论六亲谁受克，可推轻重决分毫。
yi: 哪个爻变出鬼，是哪个人犯的；哪个人的本命落在官鬼上，是哪个人遭殃；
再看六亲里谁受克，轻重就能推出来，判断得分毫不差。
en: Whichever line changes into a ghost, that person has offended; whichever natal branch sits on the Pressure line, that person suffers;
moreover see which of the six relations is controlled, and severity can be worked out and judged to the finest degree.

zh: 又论合家病疾有无，须寻用象。
父爻化鬼灾至椿萱。
兄象化官祸延手足。
子化官爻，殃从儿女。
财之用象，病在妻奴。
宫化宫爻，令门受患。
世化官爻，病临自己；
应之鬼位，妻妾不宁。
复查人之本命临官，必主为灾；
假令占得某卦，午火临官便曰属马生人受患，余照其详。
鬼若空亡，不依此断，更看六亲之象，不可受伤。
财动则祸忧尊长，鬼兴则殃及兄弟，兄摇妻病，父动儿灾，妻若来占，子动夫君受患。
其余问卜，子兴皆作康宁。
问病有无，卦内忌神不动，鬼不交重，用神不值旬空月破，便言平安。
yi: 再说全家有没有人生病，要去找用象。
父爻变出鬼，灾落到父母身上。
兄象变出官，祸延及兄弟姐妹。
子孙变出官爻，灾殃从儿女来。
财爻这个用象，病在妻子和仆人。
宫变出宫爻，令门受患。
世变出官爻，病落在自己身上；
应位是鬼，妻妾不安宁。
再查每个人的本命，落在官鬼上的，一定成灾；
假如占得某一卦，午火临在官鬼上，就说属马的人受患，其余照这样详推。
鬼如果空亡，不按这样断，要再看六亲的象，不能受伤。
财爻动，祸事忧及长辈；鬼兴旺，灾殃波及兄弟；兄弟摇动，妻子生病；父爻动，儿女有灾；如果妻子来占，子孙动，丈夫受患。
其余占问，子孙兴旺都是平安。
问有没有病，卦里忌神不动，鬼不发动，用神不遇旬空、月破，就说平安。
en: Again, to judge whether anyone in the whole household falls ill, one must find the Subject image.
If the Resource line changes into a ghost, calamity reaches the father and mother.
If the Peer image changes into Pressure, misfortune spreads to brothers and sisters.
If Output changes into a Pressure line, misfortune comes through the children.
For the Wealth image, the illness lies with the wife and servants.
Palace changing into a palace line: the honoured household suffers.
The Self changing into a Pressure line: the illness falls on oneself;
the Other's place being the ghost: wife and concubines are unsettled.
Then check each person's natal branch: whoever's falls on the Pressure line will surely suffer calamity;
suppose a certain hexagram is obtained and Wu Fire sits on the Pressure line, then say the person born in the year of the Horse suffers; the rest follow this in detail.
If the ghost is Void, do not judge this way, but look further at the image of the six relations, which must not be harmed.

Wealth moving, misfortune worries the elders; the ghost thriving, calamity reaches the brothers; the Peer stirring, the wife falls ill; the Resource moving, the children have calamity; if the wife divines and Output moves, the husband suffers.
In all other questions, Output thriving means peace.
To ask whether there is illness: if the Adversary in the hexagram is still, the ghost does not move, and the Subject does not meet Void or Month-break, say all is well.

note.yi: 「椿萱」是父母（椿指父，萱指母）。「宫化宫爻，令门受患」的「宫」疑是「官」之误（官变官爻，牵连别人家的门户），原文写的是「宫」，这里照字面译，读法没有把握。「本命临官」是按每个人生年的地支，看落在哪一爻的官鬼上——午火官鬼对属马的人，说的是这个意思。这一条和易冒「爻变之鬼亦然」（LY.ILL.YM.33）、「问痘见何人」（LY.ILL.YM.06）、黄金策的「鬼动化出六亲即以化出者断」（LY.ILL.HJC.108）是同一路读法。
note.en: 'Chun-xuan' (the Chun tree and the day-lily) is father and mother (the Chun tree for the father, the day-lily for the mother). In 'palace changing into a palace line, the honoured household suffers' the 'palace' looks like an error for 'official' (Pressure changing into a Pressure line, involving the household of another), but the original writes 'palace', and it is translated literally, the reading being uncertain. 'The natal branch sitting on the Pressure line' goes by the earthly branch of each person's birth year and sees which Pressure line it falls on: a Wu Fire Pressure line for someone born in the year of the Horse is what is meant. This entry reads in the same way as the Yi Mao's 'the ghost that appears by change is also the same' (LY.ILL.YM.33), 'who will have the pox' (LY.ILL.YM.06) and the Huangjin Ce's 'a ghost moving into a relation is judged by what it turns into' (LY.ILL.HJC.108).

units.chapter_en: Chapter 66: Where the illness was contracted
units.title: 何处得病（方位）：动爻取方（火动南、水动北）；爻静取外卦；卦安静又无鬼则看伏鬼上的飞爻定方向；飞神伏鬼皆空则无邪祟——例家人、讼、遁、小畜

rule.yi: 要知道灾星从哪里起，要把交（动）、复（变）的方位弄准：爻静就取外卦；没有官鬼，就到本宫去找；要推官鬼伏在哪一爻下面，鬼上面的飞爻才有缘由。比如占得家人卦，鬼伏在三爻辛酉金之下，只看飞神是己亥水，就说西北方冒犯了灵神；飞神、伏鬼都空的，病人终究没有邪祟侵扰。注说：占从哪里得灾、冒犯了哪个方位的祟，不论卦里有鬼没有鬼，只要见动爻，就用动爻来取；火动是南，水动是北；卦如果安静而有官鬼，就取外卦来断，外巽是东南起祸，外乾是西北招殃；卦安静又没有鬼的，不取外卦，看鬼伏在哪一爻之下，由鬼上面的飞爻定方向，比如讼卦安静，鬼伏在三爻午火之下，就说病起南方；又如遁卦三爻、六爻动，有动爻就以动爻为准，动申是西南，戌是西北，病从一处来哪有两个方向，一定要两个并看，就只说西方；又如遁卦安静，卦里虽有鬼却没有动爻，就用外卦来断，祸从西北来；又如小畜卦初爻、二爻动，官鬼虽然没有，动爻可以取，子当正北，寅是东北，两个象一起推，总说在北；又如小畜卦，无官难取外卦，才看鬼伏在三爻之下，祟从西北方来；卦里如果没有鬼，伏鬼又空，就没有神祟。
rule.en: To know from where the star of calamity rose, get the directions of the moving and the returning lines right: if the lines are still, take the outer trigram; if there is no Pressure line, look in the home palace; work out under which line the Pressure line lies hidden, for the flying line above the ghost gives the reason. Suppose Jiaren is obtained, with the ghost hidden under the third line, Xinyou Metal; just look at the flying line, Jihai Water, and say the northwest has offended a spirit; if both the flying line and the hidden ghost are Void, the patient in the end is not invaded by evil influences. The commentary says: to divine from where the calamity was got and in which direction the haunting was offended, whether or not the hexagram has a ghost, if there is a moving line, take it by the moving line; a moving Fire is south and a moving Water is north; if the hexagram is still but has a Pressure line, judge by the outer trigram, so that an outer Xun means misfortune rising in the southeast and an outer Qian means calamity from the northwest; if the hexagram is still and has no ghost, do not take the outer trigram, but see under which line the ghost lies hidden and fix the direction by the flying line above the ghost, so that in a still Song with the ghost hidden under the third line, Wu Fire, one says the illness rose in the south; again in Dun with the third and sixth lines moving, with moving lines go by the moving lines, a moving Shen is southwest and Xu northwest, and since the illness comes from one place and not two directions, if the two must be looked at together, say only west; again in a still Dun, although the hexagram has a ghost there is no moving line, so judge by the outer trigram, and the misfortune comes from the northwest; again in Xiaoxu with the first and second lines moving, although there is no Pressure line the moving lines can be taken, Zi being due north and Yin northeast, and reckoning the two images together one says only north; again in Xiaoxu, when there is no Pressure line and the outer trigram is hard to take, look at the ghost hidden under the third line, and the haunting comes from the northwest; and if the hexagram has no ghost and the hidden ghost is again Void, there is no haunting by a spirit.

zh: 以官爻为主，动象为凭。
yi: 以官爻为主，以动象为凭。
en: The Pressure line is the main line, and the moving image is the ground.

zh: 欲知何处起灾星，须把交复位向真，
爻静可将外卦取，无官却在本宫寻，
当推官伏何爻下，鬼上飞爻方有因，
假令卜得家人卦，鬼伏三爻辛酉金，
但看飞神己亥水，便言西北犯灵神，
飞官伏鬼皆空者，病体终无邪祟侵。
yi: 想知道灾星从哪里起，要把交、复（动与变）的方位弄准，
爻静就可以取外卦，没有官鬼，就到本宫去找，
要推官鬼伏在哪一爻下面，鬼上面的飞爻才有缘由。
比如占得家人卦，鬼伏在三爻辛酉金之下，
只看飞神是己亥水，就说西北方冒犯了灵神；
飞神、伏鬼都空的，病人终究没有邪祟侵扰。
en: To know from where the star of calamity rose, one must get the directions of the moving and the returning lines right;
if the lines are still, the outer trigram can be taken; if there is no Pressure line, look in the home palace,
and work out under which line the Pressure line lies hidden, for the flying line above the ghost gives the reason.
Suppose Jiaren is obtained, with the ghost hidden under the third line, Xinyou Metal;
just look at the flying line, Jihai Water, and say the northwest has offended a spirit;
if both the flying line and the hidden ghost are Void, the patient in the end is not invaded by evil influences.

zh: 凡占何处得灾，并看何方犯祟，不论卦中有鬼无鬼，如见动爻，即以动爻取之。
火动曰南，水动曰北，如卦安静亦有官鬼，便取外卦断之。
外巽则东南起祸，外乾则西北招殃。
卦若安静又无鬼者，并不取外卦而推，却看鬼伏在何爻之下，鬼上飞爻定其方向，假令讼卦安静，鬼伏三爻午火之下，便云病起南方。
又如遁卦三爻六爻动，既有动爻便言动，动申是西南，戌乃西北，病从一处岂有二方？
即要二者并看，只曰西方。
又如遁卦安静，卦虽有鬼并无动爻，便将外卦而决，祸从西北而来。
又如小畜卦初爻二爻动，官鬼虽无，动爻可取鬼当正北，寅为东北，二象并推总言在北。
又如小畜卦初爻二爻动，无官难取外卦，方看鬼伏三爻之下，祟于西北方来，卦如无鬼伏鬼再空，并无神祟。
yi: 凡是占从哪里得灾、冒犯了哪个方位的祟，不论卦里有鬼没有鬼，只要见动爻，就用动爻来取。
火动是南，水动是北；卦如果安静而有官鬼，就取外卦来断。
外巽就是东南起祸，外乾就是西北招殃。
卦安静又没有鬼的，不取外卦，却看鬼伏在哪一爻之下，由鬼上面的飞爻定方向，比如讼卦安静，鬼伏在三爻午火之下，就说病起南方。
又如遁卦三爻、六爻动，有动爻就以动爻为准，动申是西南，戌是西北，病从一处来，哪有两个方向？
如果一定要两个并看，就只说西方。
又如遁卦安静，卦里虽然有鬼却没有动爻，就用外卦来断，祸从西北来。
又如小畜卦初爻、二爻动，官鬼虽然没有，动爻可以取，子当正北，寅是东北，两个象一起推，总说在北。
又如小畜卦初爻、二爻动，没有官鬼、难取外卦，才看鬼伏在三爻之下，祟从西北方来；卦里如果没有鬼，伏鬼又空，就没有神祟。
en: To divine from where the calamity was got and in which direction the haunting was offended, whether or not the hexagram has a ghost, if a moving line is seen, take it by the moving line.
A moving Fire is south and a moving Water is north; if the hexagram is still but has a Pressure line, judge by the outer trigram.
An outer Xun means misfortune rising in the southeast, and an outer Qian means calamity from the northwest.

If the hexagram is still and has no ghost, do not take the outer trigram, but see under which line the ghost lies hidden and fix the direction by the flying line above the ghost: for example, in a still Song with the ghost hidden under the third line, Wu Fire, one says the illness rose in the south.

Again, in Dun with the third and sixth lines moving, with moving lines go by the moving lines; a moving Shen is southwest and Xu northwest, but the illness comes from one place, how can there be two directions?
If the two must be looked at together, say only west.
Again, in a still Dun, although the hexagram has a ghost there is no moving line, so judge by the outer trigram, and the misfortune comes from the northwest.

Again, in Xiaoxu with the first and second lines moving, although there is no Pressure line the moving lines can be taken, Zi being due north and Yin northeast, and reckoning the two images together one says only north.

Again, in Xiaoxu with the first and second lines moving, when there is no Pressure line and the outer trigram is hard to take, look at the ghost hidden under the third line, and the haunting comes from the northwest; and if the hexagram has no ghost and the hidden ghost is again Void, there is no haunting by a spirit.

note.yi: 「交复位向」原文如此；「复」疑是「伏」之误（交伏位向：动爻和伏神的方位），因为歌诀后面几句讲的正是动爻取方、伏鬼看飞爻。这里照字面译成「交、复（动与变）」，读法没有把握。三个方位法的先后是：先看动爻（不论有鬼没鬼），没有动爻再看外卦（有官鬼的话），卦安静又没有鬼才看伏鬼上面的飞爻——这和易冒「病从何起」（LY.ILL.YM.29）的次序略有不同：易冒把鬼同动、鬼独发分开，而且六爻俱静才取外卦、卦无官鬼才取伏鬼的飞爻。例里的卦：讼卦鬼伏在三爻午火之下，遁卦动申戌取西方，小畜动子寅取北；家人卦鬼伏辛酉下，飞神己亥水在西北。
note.en: 'Jiao fu wei xiang' is as in the original; 'fu' (returning) looks like an error for 'fu' (hidden) — the direction of moving and hidden lines — because the following lines of the verse are precisely about taking the direction from the moving line and reading a hidden ghost by the flying line. It is translated literally as 'the moving and the returning (moving and changing) lines', the reading being uncertain. The order of the three methods of finding the direction is: first the moving line (whether or not there is a ghost), if there is no moving line then the outer trigram (if there is a Pressure line), and only if the hexagram is still and has no ghost the flying line above the hidden ghost; this differs slightly from the Yi Mao's 'where the illness rose from' (LY.ILL.YM.29), which separates the ghost moving together with others from the ghost moving alone, and takes the outer trigram only when all six lines are still and the flying line of a hidden ghost only when the hexagram has no Pressure line. The hexagrams in the cases: in Song the ghost lies hidden under the third line, Wu Fire; in Dun a moving Shen and Xu give west; in Xiaoxu a moving Zi and Yin give north; in Jiaren the ghost lies under Xinyou, and the flying line Jihai Water is in the northwest.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 66: Where the illness was contracted
units.title: 按八宫论病起何处：坤坟野、艮山林、离窑炉、乾兑寺庙、震巽树林花草路、坎江河池沼；鬼值本宫非出境；独发看地支所属之方；乱动照八卦推，鬼在本宫或内卦为当地之灾、在外卦或他宫为外方之灾

rule.yi: 坤宫鬼旺，是遭了坟地野外；艮宫官动，是起于山林；离宫，或是到了窑炉的地方；乾、兑，是曾冲犯寺庙的门；震、巽，是树林花草和道路；坎卦，是江河池沼村落。鬼在本宫，不是出了境；官鬼在别的宫惹祸，又另外评断。注说：官鬼发动时，不像前面那样断：鬼在坤宫，一定是往西南犯了祟、或者登了坟墓、或者在田野之间；鬼在艮宫，曾经去过东北，不然就是往山林；鬼在离宫，南方染的祸、或者去了火场、或者到了窑炉的地方；鬼在兑宫，正西有所冒犯，或者去了庵堂、或者住在水口；鬼在震宫，正东惹祸，或者去了树林下、或者上了船轿；巽宫鬼发，曾经走过东南、或者到了竹园旁边、或者住在柴草旁；鬼在坎宫，病从北方来，或者踏过江湖之口、或者遇上骤雨淋身。鬼如果独发，再看地支所属的方位，比如贲卦初爻独发，病起东方，其余都照这样；鬼不是独发的，就不必说；卦爻乱动，照前面的八卦推，再看鬼在本宫或在内卦，就说当地的灾；鬼在外卦或者在他宫动的，要推病起于外地，学的人自己要变通。
rule.en: A ghost thriving in Kun means graves and open country; Pressure moving in Gen rises from mountain and forest; in Li, perhaps a kiln or furnace; in Qian and Dui, having struck against the gate of a temple; in Zhen and Xun, woods, flowers and paths; in Kan, rivers, pools and villages. A ghost in its home palace has not left the region; trouble incurred in another quarter is judged otherwise. The commentary says: when the Pressure line moves, judgment is not as above: a ghost in Kun surely means offending a haunting in the southwest, or climbing a grave, or being in the fields; in Gen he has gone northeast, or else to the mountains and forest; in Li, misfortune caught in the south, or a trip to a fire ground or a kiln; in Dui, an offence in the due west, or a trip to a hermitage, or living by a water mouth; in Zhen, misfortune in the due east, or being under the trees or in a boat or sedan; a ghost moving in Xun, he has walked the southeast, or been by a bamboo garden, or by firewood and grass; a ghost in Kan, the illness came from the north, or he trod on the mouth of a river or lake, or was soaked in a sudden rain. If the ghost moves alone, look again at the direction the earthly branch belongs to, so that in Bi with the first line moving alone the illness rose in the east, and the rest follow this; if the ghost does not move alone there is no need to say more; if the lines move in disorder, reckon by the eight trigrams as above, and see whether the ghost is in the home palace or the inner trigram, which is a local calamity; a ghost in the outer trigram, or moving in another palace, calls for the illness to have risen in a place outside, and the learner must adapt.

zh: 坤象鬼兴遭坟野，艮家官动起山林，离宫或到窑炉处，
乾兑曾冲寺庙门，震巽树林花草路，坎卦江河池沼村。
鬼值本宫非出境，官方惹祸却评论。
yi: 坤宫鬼旺，是遭了坟地野外；艮宫官动，是起于山林；离宫，或是到了窑炉的地方；
乾、兑，是曾冲犯寺庙的门；震、巽，是树林花草和道路；坎卦，是江河池沼村落。
鬼在本宫，不是出了境；官鬼在别的宫惹祸，又另外评断。
en: A ghost thriving in Kun means graves and open country; Pressure moving in Gen rises from mountain and forest; in Li, perhaps a kiln or furnace;
in Qian and Dui, having struck against the gate of a temple; in Zhen and Xun, woods, flowers and paths; in Kan, rivers, pools and villages.
A ghost in its home palace has not left the region; trouble incurred in another quarter is judged otherwise.

zh: 官若动时，亦不如前所断。
鬼在坤宫，必往西南犯祟、或登坟墓、或田野之间。
鬼在艮宫，曾行东北，不然便往山林。
鬼在离宫，南方染祸、或往火场、或到窑炉之所。
鬼在坤宫，理推西南、或到寺观之中、或步高楼之上。
鬼在兑宫，正西有犯、或往庵堂、或居水口。
鬼在震宫，正东惹祸、或往树林之下、或登船轿之中。
巽宫鬼发，曾步东南或到竹园之侧、或居柴草之傍。
鬼在坎宫，病从北至、或履江湖之口、或逢骤雨淋身。
鬼如独发，又看地支所属之方，假令贲卦初爻独发，病起东方，余皆仿此宫。
鬼如不独发，则不必言也。
如爻乱动，照前八卦推之，又看鬼在本宫或在内卦，便言当地之灾。
鬼在外卦或在他宫动者，当推病起外方，学者自宜通变。
yi: 官鬼发动时，不像前面那样断。
鬼在坤宫，一定是往西南犯了祟、或者登了坟墓、或者在田野之间。
鬼在艮宫，曾经去过东北，不然就是往山林。
鬼在离宫，是南方染的祸、或者去了火场、或者到了窑炉的地方。
鬼在坤宫（原文重复，疑是乾宫），推在西南、或者到了寺观里、或者登上高楼。
鬼在兑宫，正西有所冒犯，或者去了庵堂、或者住在水口。
鬼在震宫，正东惹祸，或者去了树林之下、或者上了船轿之中。
巽宫鬼发，曾经走过东南、或者到了竹园旁边、或者住在柴草旁边。
鬼在坎宫，病从北方来，或者踏过江湖之口、或者遇上骤雨淋身。
鬼如果独发，再看地支所属的方位，比如贲卦初爻独发，病起于东方，其余都照这个宫来推。
鬼不是独发的，就不必说了。
如果爻乱动，照前面的八卦去推，再看鬼在本宫或者在内卦，就说当地的灾。
鬼在外卦，或者在别的宫动的，要推病起于外地，学的人自己要变通。
en: When the Pressure line moves, judgment is not as above.
A ghost in Kun surely means offending a haunting in the southwest, or climbing a grave, or being in the fields.
A ghost in Gen means he has gone northeast, or else to the mountains and forest.
A ghost in Li means misfortune caught in the south, or a trip to a fire ground or a kiln.
A ghost in Kun (repeated in the original, probably Qian) is worked out as southwest, or a visit to a temple or abbey, or climbing a high tower.
A ghost in Dui means an offence in the due west, or a trip to a hermitage, or living by a water mouth.
A ghost in Zhen means misfortune in the due east, or being under the trees, or riding in a boat or sedan.
A ghost moving in Xun means he has walked the southeast, or been by a bamboo garden, or lodged by firewood and grass.
A ghost in Kan means the illness came from the north, or he trod on the mouth of a river or lake, or was soaked in a sudden rain.

If the ghost moves alone, look again at the direction the earthly branch belongs to: for example, in Bi (Adornment) with the first line moving alone the illness rose in the east, and the rest follow this palace.
If the ghost does not move alone, there is no need to say more.
If the lines move in disorder, reckon by the eight trigrams as above, and see whether the ghost is in the home palace or the inner trigram, which is a local calamity.
A ghost in the outer trigram, or moving in another palace, calls for the illness to have risen in a place outside, and the learner must adapt.

note.yi: 这一条是上一条（LY.ILL.EL.03）的「之一」，专讲鬼在哪个宫里动。原文注里「鬼在坤宫」出现了两次，第二次配的是「寺观、高楼」，而寺观、高楼在别处配的是乾宫（见 LY.ILL.EL.04 歌诀「乾兑曾冲寺庙门」和易冒 LY.ILL.YM.57），所以第二个「坤宫」疑是「乾宫」之误，这里照字面译，只在括号里标出。「水口」是水流出入的地方。「本宫」「内卦」是当地，「外卦」「他宫」是外地。八宫配的处所与易冒鬼神章的八宫配法（LY.ILL.YM.57）、黄金策的八宫推鬼神（LY.ILL.HJC.95）是同一套八卦象，细目不同。
note.en: This is the 'first' of the sequel to the last entry (LY.ILL.EL.03), and speaks only of the palace in which the ghost moves. In the note 'a ghost in Kun' occurs twice, and the second is paired with 'temples and abbeys, a high tower', which are elsewhere paired with Qian (see the verse of this entry, 'in Qian and Dui, having struck against the gate of a temple', and the Yi Mao's LY.ILL.YM.57), so the second 'Kun' looks like an error for 'Qian'; it is translated literally, with the doubt marked in brackets. A 'water mouth' is a place where water flows in or out. The 'home palace' and the 'inner trigram' are the local place, and the 'outer trigram' and 'another palace' are a place elsewhere. The places assigned to the eight palaces are the same images of the trigrams as in the Yi Mao's assignments in the chapter on ghosts and spirits (LY.ILL.YM.57) and the Huangjin Ce's reading by the eight palaces (LY.ILL.HJC.95), with differences of detail.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 66: Where the illness was contracted
units.title: 按六神论病由何得：青龙鬼动因喜处亲友酒席、朱雀因恼怒词讼文章、勾陈因跌磕坟田动作、螣蛇因惊恐思虑妖邪、白虎因哀声丧事兵刀宰杀、玄武因酒色水路冒雨盗失

rule.yi: 鬼带青龙发动，是因为权势和喜悦，或者是去了亲友办喜事的人家、到了树林芳草的地方、或者叨扰了酒席和簪花——灾由喜处来，或探亲访友、酬酒簪花、游山、居树下、谒贵人，这些地方病由此得。鬼带朱雀，是因为恼怒，是非、词讼和文章，看书、写字、唱歌都是生灾惹祸的缘由——灾由怒气来，或被闲非词讼、或写书修书、或遇喧哗、或逢歌耍、或看火场沾上灾祸。鬼带勾陈发动，病难痊愈，或许到过田边、坟前坟后，或是为别人修造、自己动工，莫非是犯了禁忌牵连上了——灾由跌磕来，或登过坟左墓右、行过地后田前、内外动过工，所以有灾瘴。螣蛇带着鬼爻兴旺，病是惊惶恐吓造成的，或是被七情伤了气血，或是遇上鬼魅作妖精——灾由惊恐、多思虑、忧愁或遇妖邪来。白虎临着官鬼兴旺，或听见邻近有悲声、看见撤席行丧经过、看见兵戈和宰牲——祸起于哀声，邻里的丧事、新朋的撤席、去了孝堂之内、看见刀兵或遇上宰杀，这几样祸都从这里出。玄武是从水路来的，或贪酒色得的灾，或洗浴又遇雨，或受了寒邪病更乘势——玄武临官，灾由酒色、往江河、冒雨、失物、被盗惊起病。
rule.en: A ghost moving with the Azure Dragon comes from power and delight, or from going to the house of a relative or friend holding a happy event, to woods and fragrant grass, or from taking part in wine drinking and putting flowers in the hair; the calamity comes from a place of joy, or from visiting relatives and friends, toasting and wearing flowers, touring the hills, dwelling under trees or calling on a noble, and the illness was contracted in one of these ways. A ghost with the Vermilion Bird comes from vexation and anger, quarrels, lawsuits and writing; reading, writing and singing are all ways of bringing on calamity; the calamity comes from anger, from idle quarrels and lawsuits, from writing or revising books, from meeting uproar, from songs and play, or from watching a fire ground. A ghost moving with Hook Earth makes the illness hard to cure; perhaps he went by fields or in front of or behind a grave, or built for another or did works himself, and surely a taboo is implicated; the calamity comes from a knock or fall, from climbing to the left or right of a grave, walking behind the ground or before the field, or doing works inside or outside, and hence the calamity and miasma. If the Coiling Snake carries a thriving Pressure line, the illness is made by fright and terror, or the seven emotions have harmed the qi and blood, or ghosts and sprites have made demons; the calamity comes from fright, from much brooding, from grief or from meeting demons and evil. The White Tiger sitting on a thriving Pressure line: perhaps he heard weeping nearby, watched a funeral banquet cleared away or a funeral pass, or saw weapons or the slaughter of animals; the misfortune rises from the sound of mourning, a neighbour's funeral, a new friend's cleared table, going into a house of mourning, or seeing weapons or meeting slaughter, and from these several kinds misfortune comes. The Dark Tortoise comes by the water road, or the calamity is got from greed for wine and lust, or he bathed and also met rain, or took in cold evil, and the illness rode further; with the Dark Tortoise on the Pressure line, the calamity comes from wine and lust, going to river or lake, being out in the rain, losing goods or being frightened by theft.

zh: 青龙鬼动因权悦，或往亲朋喜事家，
或到树林芳草处，或叨酌酒及簪花。
yi: 青龙带鬼发动，是因为权势和喜悦，或者是去了亲友办喜事的人家；
或者到了树林芳草的地方，或者叨扰了酒席和簪花。
en: A ghost moving with the Azure Dragon comes from power and delight, or from going to the house of a relative or friend holding a happy event;
or from going to woods and fragrant grass, or from taking part in wine drinking and putting flowers in the hair.

zh: 鬼值青龙，灾由喜处、或探亲访友、或酬酒簪花、或去游山、或居树下、或谒贵人，以上等方病从此得。
yi: 鬼带青龙，灾由喜处来，或探亲访友、或酬酒簪花、或去游山、或住在树下、或拜见贵人，这些地方病由此得。
en: A ghost with the Azure Dragon: the calamity comes from a place of joy, or from visiting relatives and friends, or toasting and wearing flowers, or from touring the hills, or dwelling under trees, or calling on a noble; the illness was contracted in one of these ways.

zh: 朱雀鬼兴因恼怒，是非词讼及文章，
看书写字兼歌唱，皆是生灾惹祸方。
yi: 朱雀带鬼兴旺，是因为恼怒，是非、词讼和文章；
看书、写字以及唱歌，都是生灾惹祸的缘由。
en: A ghost thriving with the Vermilion Bird comes from vexation and anger, quarrels, lawsuits and writing;
reading, writing and singing are all ways of bringing on calamity.

zh: 鬼临朱雀，灾由怒气，或被闲非词讼或曾写书修书或遇喧哗或逢歌耍、或视火场染其灾祸。
yi: 鬼临朱雀，灾由怒气来，或被闲非词讼、或写书修书、或遇喧哗、或逢歌耍、或看火场沾上灾祸。
en: A ghost on the Vermilion Bird: the calamity comes from anger, from idle quarrels and lawsuits, from writing or revising books, from meeting uproar, from songs and play, or from watching a fire ground.

zh: 勾陈鬼动病难痊，倘至田傍墓后前，
或为他修并自作，莫非禁忌有牵连。
yi: 勾陈带鬼发动，病难痊愈，或许到过田边、坟前坟后；
或是为别人修造、自己动工，莫非是犯了禁忌牵连上了。
en: A ghost moving with Hook Earth makes the illness hard to cure; perhaps he went by fields or in front of or behind a grave;
or built for another or did works himself: surely a taboo is implicated.

zh: 鬼值勾陈，灾由跌磕、或登坟左墓右、或行地后田前、或曾内外动作，故有灾瘴。
yi: 鬼值勾陈，灾由跌磕来，或登过坟左墓右、或行过地后田前、或内外动过工，所以有灾瘴。
en: A ghost on Hook Earth: the calamity comes from a knock or fall, from climbing to the left or right of a grave, from walking behind the ground or before the field, or from doing works inside or outside, and hence the calamity and miasma.

zh: 螣蛇若带鬼爻兴，病为惊惶惧吓成，
或被七情伤气血，或逢鬼魅作妖精。
yi: 螣蛇如果带着鬼爻兴旺，病是惊惶恐吓造成的；
或是被七情伤了气血，或是遇上鬼魅作妖精。
en: If the Coiling Snake carries a thriving Pressure line, the illness is made by fright and terror;
or the seven emotions have harmed the qi and blood, or ghosts and sprites have made demons.

zh: 鬼值螣蛇，灾由惊恐或多思虑、或有忧愁、或遇妖邪，故生灾瘴。
yi: 鬼值螣蛇，灾由惊恐，或多思虑、或有忧愁、或遇妖邪，所以生灾瘴。
en: A ghost on the Coiling Snake: the calamity comes from fright, or much brooding, or grief, or meeting demons and evil, and hence the calamity and miasma.

zh: 白虎相临官鬼兴，或闻邻近有悲声，
或观撤席行丧过，或视兵戈及宰牲。
yi: 白虎临着官鬼兴旺，或者听见邻近有悲声，
或者看见撤席、行丧经过，或者看见兵戈和宰牲。
en: The White Tiger sitting on a thriving Pressure line: perhaps he heard weeping nearby,
or watched a funeral banquet cleared away or a funeral pass, or saw weapons or the slaughter of animals.

zh: 官临白虎，祸起哀声、或邻里之临丧、或新朋之撤席、或往孝堂之内、或见刀兵或逢宰杀，如此数般祸从斯出。
yi: 官鬼临白虎，祸起于哀声，或邻里的丧事、或新朋的撤席、或去了孝堂之内、或看见刀兵、或遇上宰杀，这几样祸都从这里出。
en: The Pressure line on the White Tiger: the misfortune rises from the sound of mourning, a neighbour's funeral, a new friend's cleared table, going into a house of mourning, or seeing weapons or meeting slaughter, and from these several kinds misfortune comes.

zh: 玄武还从水路来，或贪酒色得其灾，
或经沐浴兼逢雨，或受寒邪病更乘。
yi: 玄武是从水路来的，或者贪酒色得的灾；
或者洗浴又遇雨，或者受了寒邪病更乘势。
en: The Dark Tortoise comes by the water road, or the calamity is got from greed for wine and lust;
or he bathed and also met rain, or took in cold evil, and the illness rode further.

zh: 玄武临官，灾由酒色、或往江河、或曾冒雨、或经失物、或被盗惊起病之由，细宜斟酌。
yi: 玄武临官，灾由酒色，或去了江河、或曾冒雨、或经历失物、或被盗惊吓而起病，要细细斟酌。
en: With the Dark Tortoise on the Pressure line, the calamity comes from wine and lust, or from going to river or lake, or being out in the rain, or losing goods, or being frightened by theft; weigh it carefully.

note.yi: 六神各配一类得病的缘由：青龙是喜、酒席；朱雀是怒气、词讼、文字；勾陈是跌磕、坟田动作；螣蛇是惊恐、思虑；白虎是丧事、兵刃、宰杀；玄武是酒色、水、盗。这和易隐病因·六神（LY.ILL.YY.17）、易冒的六神配病因（LY.ILL.YM.26、YM.30）、黄金策六神临鬼各主一症（LY.ILL.HJC.05）是同一件事，各家细目略有出入；易林补遗把它写成「病是怎么得来的」（去了哪里、遇上了什么事），黄金策写的是症状。「灾瘴」是灾祸和瘴气，「簪花」是把花插在头上。
note.en: Each of the six spirits is paired with a class of cause of falling ill: the Azure Dragon joy and banquets; the Vermilion Bird anger, lawsuits and writing; Hook Earth knocks, falls and works at graves and fields; the Coiling Snake fright and brooding; the White Tiger mourning, weapons and slaughter; the Dark Tortoise wine, lust, water and theft. This is the same matter as the Yi Yin's six spirits in the causes of illness (LY.ILL.YY.17), the Yi Mao's six spirits in the causes of illness (LY.ILL.YM.26, YM.30) and the Huangjin Ce's 'each of the six spirits on the ghost governs a symptom' (LY.ILL.HJC.05), with details differing among the books; the Yilin Buyi writes it as 'how the illness was contracted' (where he went and what he met), where the Huangjin Ce writes symptoms. 'Calamity and miasma' is misfortune and pestilential air, and 'putting flowers in the hair' is wearing flowers on the head.

units.chapter: 出痘(章题缺,在第六十六章之后)
units.title: 占出痘：卦无官痘无芽、鬼空鬼绝无斑疹、官动官兴有痘；鬼动而休囚、冲散、绝乡、化克绝皆非出，官发动不临死绝刑伤便出；年上临官年出痘、月值鬼月栽花；鬼休子旺稀朗、鬼旺福衰稠密；螣蛇临火发必麻痘

rule.yi: 以官鬼为主，五行六象为凭。还没种花的时候来问种花，卦里没有官鬼的，痘就没有芽；鬼空、鬼绝，没有斑疹；官动、官兴，有痘瘀。占出痘，要看官爻：鬼如果空亡、或不上卦，一定不出；卦里纵有鬼动，也遇上休囚、或遇冲散、或落绝乡、或化出克绝，都不是出痘；官鬼发动而不临死绝刑伤，鬼即使休囚，如果变为有气，就种痘花；鬼虽不动，遇上旺相的时期，也应当起发；卦里虽无鬼，若本月临官，反倒生出痘痧。年上临官，这年出痘；月中值鬼，这个月栽花；鬼休囚、子孙旺，痘应稀朗；鬼旺、福（子孙）衰，痘更稠密；若见螣蛇临火发动，一定是麻疹和痘，断无差错。问哪一年种痘，就看鬼临生旺的年，卦里没有官，再看哪一年值鬼；占哪一个月栽花，就推鬼逢生旺的月；要知道哪一天，也看鬼旺的日子，大同小异，一个道理推；卦里官鬼休囚、子孙旺相，或子孙在世爻上，纵然出痘，也稀疏；官鬼旺相、子孙休囚，痘出来时稠密非常；还要论螣蛇临火发动，鬼虽安静，也必发痘疹。
rule.en: The Pressure line is the main line, and the five phases and six images are the ground. When asked, before the flowers are sown, about sowing the flowers, if the hexagram has no Pressure line the pox has no sprout; with the ghost Void or in Extinction there are no spots or rash; with Pressure moving and thriving there is pox with dark stasis. In divining the pox coming out, look at the Pressure line: if the ghost is Void or absent from the hexagram, it will surely not come out; even if the hexagram has a moving ghost, if it meets resting or trapped, or clash and scattering, or falls in Extinction, or changes into control or Extinction, none of it is the pox coming out; if the Pressure line moves and is not on death, Extinction, punishment or wounding, then even if the ghost is resting or trapped, if it changes into strength the flowers are sown; though the ghost does not move, meeting the period when it is strong, the pox should still rise; and though the hexagram has no ghost, if the month itself sits on Pressure, pox and rash are born instead. Pressure on the year: the pox comes out that year; the ghost on duty in the month: the flowers are planted that month; ghost resting and Output strong, the pox is sparse and clear; ghost strong and Output weak, denser still; if the Coiling Snake on Fire moves, it is sure to be measles and pox, and the judgment will not be wrong. To ask in what year to sow the pox, look at the year in which the ghost is on strength or generation, and where the hexagram has no Pressure line, look for the year on which a ghost sits; to divine in what month to plant the flowers, work out the month in which the ghost meets strength; to know the day, look also at the days when the ghost is strong, the same reasoning with small differences; if in the hexagram the Pressure line is resting or trapped and Output strong, or Output is on the Self, then even if the pox comes out it is sparse; if the Pressure line is strong and Output resting or trapped, the pox comes out extremely dense; also, if the Coiling Snake on Fire moves, though the ghost is still, pox and rash will surely come out.

zh: 以官鬼为主，五行六象为凭。
yi: 以官鬼为主，以五行六象为凭。
en: The Pressure line is the main line, and the five phases and six images are the ground.

zh: 未种花时问种花，卦无官者痘无芽，
鬼空鬼绝无斑疹，官动官兴有痘瘀。
yi: 还没种花的时候来问种花，卦里没有官鬼的，痘就没有芽；
鬼空、鬼绝，没有斑疹；官动、官兴，有痘瘀。
en: When asked, before the flowers are sown, about sowing the flowers, if the hexagram has no Pressure line the pox has no sprout;
with the ghost Void or in Extinction there are no spots or rash; with Pressure moving and thriving there is pox with dark stasis.

zh: 凡占出痘，须看官爻，鬼若空亡及不上卦，决然不出。
卦中纵有鬼动亦值休囚、或逢冲散、或遇绝乡、或化克绝，皆非出也。
官如发动不临死绝刑伤，鬼纵休囚若变为有气，便种痘花。
鬼虽不动或逢旺相之期，亦当起发。
卦虽无鬼，倘然本月临官，反生痘痧。
yi: 凡是占出痘，要看官爻：鬼如果空亡、或者不上卦，一定不出。
卦里纵然有鬼动，也遇上休囚、或者遇冲散、或者落在绝乡、或者化出克绝，都不是出痘。
官鬼发动而不临死绝刑伤，鬼即使休囚，如果变为有气，就种痘花。
鬼虽然不动，遇上旺相的时期，也应当起发。
卦里虽然没有鬼，如果本月临官，反倒生出痘痧。
en: In divining the pox coming out, look at the Pressure line: if the ghost is Void or absent from the hexagram, it will surely not come out.
Even if the hexagram has a moving ghost, if it meets resting or trapped, or clash and scattering, or falls in Extinction, or changes into control or Extinction, none of it is the pox coming out.
If the Pressure line moves and is not on death, Extinction, punishment or wounding, then even if the ghost is resting or trapped, if it changes into strength the flowers are sown.
Though the ghost does not move, meeting the period when it is strong, the pox should still rise.
Though the hexagram has no ghost, if the month itself sits on Pressure, pox and rash are born instead.

zh: 年上临官年出痘，月中值鬼月栽花，
鬼休子旺当稀朗，鬼旺福衰稠密加，
若见螣蛇临火发，定主麻痘断无差。
yi: 年上临官，这年出痘；月中值鬼，这个月栽花；
鬼休囚、子孙旺，痘应稀朗；鬼旺、福衰，痘更稠密；
如果见螣蛇临火发动，一定是麻疹和痘，断无差错。
en: Pressure on the year: the pox comes out that year; the ghost on duty in the month: the flowers are planted that month;
ghost resting and Output strong, the pox is sparse and clear; ghost strong and Output weak, denser still;
if the Coiling Snake on Fire moves, it is sure to be measles and pox, and the judgment will not be wrong.

zh: 若问何年种豆，便看鬼临生旺之年，卦若无官，又察何年值鬼。
如占何月栽花，便推鬼逢生旺之月；
要知何日，亦看鬼旺之期，大同小异一理而推。
卦中官鬼休囚子孙旺相、或值世家，纵然出痘，亦主稀疏。
官如旺相，子若休囚，痘生时下稠密非常，又论螣蛇临火发动，鬼虽安静必发痘疹。
yi: 问哪一年种痘，就看鬼临生旺的年，卦里如果没有官，再看哪一年值鬼。
占哪一个月栽花，就推鬼逢生旺的月；
要知道哪一天，也看鬼旺的日子，大同小异，一个道理推。
卦里官鬼休囚、子孙旺相，或者子孙在世爻上，纵然出痘，也稀疏。
官鬼旺相、子孙休囚，痘出来时稠密非常；还要论螣蛇临火发动，鬼虽然安静，也必发痘疹。
en: To ask in what year to sow the pox, look at the year in which the ghost is on strength or generation, and where the hexagram has no Pressure line, look for the year on which a ghost sits.
To divine in what month to plant the flowers, work out the month in which the ghost meets strength;
to know the day, look also at the days when the ghost is strong, the same reasoning with small differences.
If in the hexagram the Pressure line is resting or trapped and Output strong, or Output is on the Self, then even if the pox comes out it is sparse.

If the Pressure line is strong and Output resting or trapped, the pox comes out extremely dense; and also, if the Coiling Snake on Fire moves, though the ghost is still, pox and rash will surely come out.

note.yi: 这一段没有章题（整理本这一处缺章名），从小标「以官鬼为主，五行六象为凭」看，是讲种痘、出痘的。「种痘」「栽花」「种豆」都是指出痘、种痘这件事（「豆」是「痘」的借字）。「痘瘀」的「瘀」原意是血瘀，这里按字面译作「痘瘀」。年、月、日都用「鬼临生旺」来定：官鬼旺相的年月日就是出痘的时候。稀朗、稠密的判据和易冒（LY.ILL.YM.05）、增删卜易（LY.ILL.ZS.20）、易隐（LY.ILL.YY.35）、卜筮正宗（LY.ILL.BSZZ.06）一致：鬼休子旺则稀，鬼旺子衰则稠。
note.en: This passage has no chapter title (the edition lacks the chapter name here); from the subtitle 'the Pressure line is the main line, the five phases and six images the ground' it is about sowing and bringing out the pox. 'Sowing the pox', 'planting flowers' and 'sowing beans' all mean the pox and its inoculation ('dou', bean, is borrowed for 'dou', pox). The 'stasis' in 'pox with dark stasis' originally means blood stasis and is translated literally. The year, month and day are all fixed by 'the ghost on strength or generation': the year, month or day when the Pressure line is strong is when the pox comes out. The criteria for sparse and dense agree with the Yi Mao (LY.ILL.YM.05), the Zengshan Buyi (LY.ILL.ZS.20), the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.35) and the Bushi Zhengzong (LY.ILL.BSZZ.06): ghost resting and Output strong is sparse, ghost strong and Output weak is dense.

units.chapter: 是病非病(章题缺,在出痘之后)
units.chapter_en: Real illness or not (chapter title missing; after the pox)
units.title: 占是病不是病只论官爻：鬼交重必成此症、官不动而生旺亦断此灾、卦无鬼及落空亡或临绝处则似是而非；随官入墓助鬼伤身其祸当兴，要知病散须看子孙

rule.yi: 以官鬼为主，旺衰为凭。占疾厄是假是真，官鬼交重，病一定兴起；旺相的也会遭这个患；落空、遇绝，就是虚名。随官入墓、助鬼伤身，灾就不是假的，祸一定兴起；日、月制住官鬼，病是实还是不实要看；子孙旺动，病就难成立。注说：占是不是病，只论官爻，再没有别的说法；鬼如果交重，一定成这个症；官虽不动，如果逢生旺，也断有这个灾；卦如果没有鬼、或落空亡、或临绝处，似是而非，病不真；凡是遇上随官入墓、助鬼伤身，其祸应当兴起，灾难回避；要知道病什么时候散，要看子孙，如果子旺官衰、日月和福德，卦内子爻或动而克制，病就散。
rule.en: The Pressure line is the main line, and strength or weakness is the ground. To divine whether an ailment is false or real: if the Pressure line moves, the illness will surely rise; strong, it too suffers this trouble; Void or meeting Extinction, it is an empty name. Following into a tomb and helping the ghost to harm the Self mean the calamity is no false one, and misfortune will surely rise; if the Day and Month control the Pressure line, it remains to be seen whether it is real; Output strong and moving, and the illness is hard to make out. The commentary says: in judging whether it is an illness or not, go by the Pressure line alone, with no other opinion; if the ghost moves, it will surely make this illness; though the Pressure line does not move, if it meets generation or strength, it too means this calamity; if the hexagram has no ghost, or it is Void, or sits at Extinction, it seems so but is not, and the illness is not real; when one meets following into a tomb or helping the ghost to harm the Self, the misfortune should rise and the calamity is hard to avoid; to know when the illness will disperse, look at Output: if Output is strong and Pressure weak, or the Day and Month and the fortune spirit are on it, or Output in the hexagram moves and controls the ghost, the illness disperses.

zh: 以官鬼为主，旺衰为凭。
yi: 以官鬼为主，以旺衰为凭。
en: The Pressure line is the main line, and strength or weakness is the ground.

zh: 凡占疾厄假和真，官鬼交重病必兴，
旺相亦然遭此患，临空遇绝是虚名。
yi: 占疾厄是假是真，官鬼交重，病一定兴起，
旺相的也会遭这个患，落空、遇绝，就是虚名。
en: To divine whether an ailment is false or real: if the Pressure line moves, the illness will surely rise;
strong, it too suffers this trouble; Void or meeting Extinction, it is an empty name.

zh: 凡占是病不是病，只论官爻，再无别议。
鬼若交重，必成此症。
官虽不动，若逢生旺，亦断此灾。
卦如无鬼及落空亡、或临绝处，似是而非病不真也。
yi: 凡是占是不是病，只论官爻，再没有别的说法。
鬼如果交重，一定成这个症。
官虽然不动，如果逢生旺，也断有这个灾。
卦如果没有鬼、或落空亡、或临在绝处，似是而非，病不是真的。
en: In judging whether it is an illness or not, go by the Pressure line alone, with no other opinion.
If the ghost moves, it will surely make this illness.
Though the Pressure line does not move, if it meets generation or strength, it too means this calamity.
If the hexagram has no ghost, or it is Void, or sits at Extinction, it seems so but is not, and the illness is not real.

zh: 随官入墓灾非假，助鬼伤身祸必兴，
日月制官实不实，子孙旺动疾难凭。
yi: 随官入墓，灾就不是假的，助鬼伤身，祸一定兴起；
日、月制住官鬼，病实不实要看，子孙旺动，病就难成立。
en: Following the Pressure line into a tomb, the calamity is no false one; helping the ghost to harm the Self, misfortune will surely rise;
if the Day and Month control the Pressure line, it remains to be seen whether it is real; Output strong and moving, and the illness is hard to make out.

zh: 凡值随官入墓助鬼伤身，其祸当兴，灾难，回避。
要知病散，须看子孙。
若得子旺官衰、日月及临福德，卦内子爻或动克制。
yi: 凡是遇上随官入墓、助鬼伤身，其祸应当兴起，灾难回避。
要知道病什么时候散，要看子孙。
如果子旺官衰、日月和福德，卦内的子爻或动而克制，病就散。
en: When one meets following the Pressure line into a tomb or helping the ghost to harm the Self, the misfortune should rise and the calamity is hard to avoid.
To know when the illness will disperse, look at Output.
If Output is strong and Pressure weak, or the Day and Month and the fortune spirit are on it, or Output in the hexagram moves and controls the ghost, the illness disperses.

note.yi: 这一段也没有章题。它问的是：这算不算病，是真病还是虚惊。判断只有一个：官鬼——交重必成、生旺也成、空绝就不真。第二组歌诀是把随官入墓、助鬼伤身作为「灾非假」的两个实证，而解病的方法是子孙。「灾难，回避」原文如此，大意是灾难以躲过；最后一句「子爻或动克制」没有写完（缺后半句），按上下文译作「子爻动来克制，病就散」。与易冒的「问症发真假」（LY.ILL.YM.31）相同：鬼实则是、鬼虚则非。
note.en: This passage too has no chapter title. It asks whether this counts as illness, a real illness or a false alarm. There is only one criterion: the Pressure line — moving, it surely forms; strong, it forms; Void or in Extinction, it is not real. The second verse gives following into a tomb and helping the ghost to harm the Self as two proofs that the calamity is 'no false one', and the way to dissolve the illness is Output. 'The calamity is hard to avoid' is as in the original, meaning the calamity can hardly be escaped; the last sentence, 'Output in the hexagram moves and controls', breaks off without the second half and is translated from the context as 'Output moves and controls, and the illness disperses'. It agrees with the Yi Mao on whether the outbreak of symptoms is real (LY.ILL.YM.31): when the ghost is full it is real, and when the ghost is empty it is not.
